name: Las Vegas
summary: The neon oasis — the Strip's spectacle, old-school Fremont Street, and the engineering marvel of Hoover Dam nearby. The last big blast before California.

commute.scenicNote: I-15 northeast, and the best twenty minutes of interstate in America through the Virgin River Gorge — the road was blasted through the canyon and crosses the river a dozen times. Clip the corner of Arizona on the way.
